name: M3_MMS120MI_AllocateOrdLine
description: Allocate a specific order line to available stock for a given stock transaction type and allocation origin. This operation performs the same high-level allocation as Allocation. Perform (MMS120) but is limited to one line, for example a single customer or distribution order line. It uses the order number, order line, and optional line suffix to identify the demand, then reserves allocatable on-hand balance according to standard M3 allocation rules. Use this instead of the full-order allocation operation when only one line requires allocation or a different quantity.

inputParameters.name: TTYP
inputParameters.description: Stock transaction type for the order line being allocated.

inputParameters.name: RIDN
inputParameters.description: Order number for the order whose line is being allocated.

inputParameters.name: RIDL
inputParameters.description: Order line number on the order whose balance will be allocated.

inputParameters.name: MAAL
inputParameters.description: Code specifying the origin or method of the allocation, such as manual or automatic.

inputParameters.name: RIDX
inputParameters.description: Line suffix identifying the subline or sequence on the order line being allocated, when applicable.

inputParameters.name: ALQT
inputParameters.description: Quantity to allocate in the item's basic unit of measure.
